family: A. Absorption and ending (29 dynamics; 317 Lean laws: 298 with premise rows in dynamics.json, 19 more that appear only as exits)
in_one_paragraph: The draft holds for the middle of family A, bends on its commonest word, and breaks on about a quarter of its laws. It holds where a law is about something living on a stock: the three-outcomes laws (Dependence.lean:254, 269, 284) type exactly as marks on three lines, one of them a relation ("it needs it") that is itself kept, weakened or dissolved. That is the best evidence in the family that a relation can be a line. It bends on "ends": in this family that one mark stands for at least eight Lean predicates (not active at one step; never active from a step; for good; ends on every branch with no step named; level at nothing; the empty state closed; no member in a cohort; the guard left), and the Lean proves several of them apart. It breaks on laws of any line whatever (leaving takes a step that does not keep), laws about a border itself, counting identities, calibrations, and laws about what a sighting tells. Family A is not a neighbourhood of the map: it is the "ends" side of lines that B, H, G, F and the first region also speak of.

lines.what: something that goes on. In this family: a formation, a whole, a line of descent, something drawing on a stock, a line from one occurrence
lines.marks: forms: `W.Arises t f`; no law here makes one form except through a part arising or a gated step (Gated.origin). lasts: `W.active t f` step by step; from T on, `∀ t, T ≤ t → W.active t w` (AllWhole.persists_iff); on some branch, the root's 延 / 生成 (LineageRegimes.Handover.both_fates). changes: goes on with its tie to what it lived on weakened, dissolved or moved (`Web.DependenceChanged`; Substitution.persists_consuming); a whole diminished (Grade.diminished_iff). ends: five different predicates: `¬ W.active t g` at one step (premise web-not-active); `W.Ends p`, never active from some step (web-ends); for good only with the further premise web-ending-final; the root's 退化 / 尽, on every branch with no step named (grammarmap-jin); `lineage G h … = []`.
lines.shared_with: Every family. With B and H by the same Lean types (`Web`, `Flow`), not by a reading.

lines.what: its parts
lines.marks: forms: `W.Arises t p`. lasts: active. changes: the count of active parts (`W.Grade ps t n`) moves only as a part arises or ceases (Grade.across_step: n' + c = n + a). ends: `W.Ceases t p`, `W.Ends p`. Premises web-part, web-allwhole, web-whole, web-atleastwhole.

lines.shared_with: B: own-count-misses-joint-excess, the-rest-outruns-the-renewal, position-does-not-protect (their laws are recorded case_of A's Flow.ends_below_at and Flow.never_returns_below). What A's laws take of it is mostly a FORM, not a mark: giving stops below a need (`Gated g m`; flow-gated: what gives itself needs it), falls short below y (`Short`), meets the draw from y (`Meets`), rises with what is left (`Rises`). lasts: meets the draw. ends: nothing from nothing.

laws.if_: any determined law; no premise
laws.then_: a state (t1 at the grain of one state): ends for good (drawn into a region never left) exactly where it does not last by coming round
laws.note: No tie between two lines. It says what "ends for good" means for anything under one fixed law. The entry itself calls it near-definitional.

laws.if_: NEW-any: holds at step n, does not hold at step n + 1
laws.then_: the step taken at n is one that does not keep it
laws.note: THEN is about a step, not a line's mark. Same law as 内至外之线有出步, Gated.leaving_passes_gate and ceases_at_a_step: one law of every line, proved four times in this family.

laws.if_: every state is on a list of m; one fixed law
laws.then_: every course is at a state that comes round before step m
laws.note: About every course of a whole finite world; the time bound is a count of states.

laws.if_: any process (courses branch); no premise
laws.then_: a state: ends for good ON EVERY COURSE exactly where it does not come round
laws.note: The mark needs "on every course / on some course". The witness OneWay.possibly_not_necessarily has a state drawn on some course and coming round on another.

laws.if_: NEW-any (state s can still be had): lasts by coming round at s; a course from s reaches t where s cannot be had
laws.then_: not not: on that course there is a point with one step that keeps s and one that loses it, and the losing step was taken there
laws.note: The border is a place on a course, not an amount. Only up to double negation; finding it for every loss is LPO (lpo_of_junctures_found, Junctures.lean:575).

laws.if_: only the steps after which s can still be had are taken
laws.then_: NEW-any (s can still be had): lasts

laws.if_: two courses alike before step D but for a source; what decides the step at x reads only through its couplings up to D; its step keeps s in one course and loses it in the other
laws.then_: r9: the source reached it by D (not not); and x is a fork for s
laws.note: A comparison of times (before D) and of two courses. Its premises are the first region's (timedresponse-*).

laws.if_: NEW-any: closed under the relation
laws.then_: NEW-any: nothing in it bears the relation to something outside
laws.note: Root grammar, any carrier, relation and region; the entry says these laws choose no boundary.

laws.if_: every step of continuation either keeps to the region or goes out of it; a line runs from a member to something outside
laws.then_: NEW-any: ends at a step going out, placed on the line (reached from the start, reaching the end)
laws.note: Recorded case_of the root's 两端分则中有标.

laws.if_: t1 (a line from an occurrence, at a sameness finer than activity): active at its start; nothing it reaches is active at one step N not before the start
laws.then_: t1: ends on every branch (退化)
laws.note: States the root's own predicate on the World. No step of ending is named.

laws.if_: standing: activity needs support. t3: below the need at every step after T. r4: still held at step N by everything the line reaches. t1: active at its start, not after N
laws.then_: t1: ends on every branch
laws.note: Three lines, one mark each. The premise on t3 is "at every later step", which no sighting establishes.

laws.lean: Becoming.«尽则有终当且仅当排中» (GrammarMap.lean:584)
laws.if_: (none)
laws.then_: "every line that ends on every branch reaches an end" holds for all lines exactly when excluded middle does
laws.note: Not a tie between lines. It says what it takes to turn "ends" into "ends at this point".

laws.if_: t3: below m at step T. r3 has the form of a gate: whatever gives to it needs it at m or more, and is supplied. Balance at it over the next n steps
laws.then_: t3: still below m after those n steps (it does not come back)
laws.note: The decisive premise is a FORM of a tie (what gives back itself lives on it), not a mark. Stated over a stretch, so a case can meet it; the whole-run form is Flow.stays_below.

laws.if_: at one step: t1 is active only where supplied; t3 is below m; r4: t1 needs it at m or more
laws.then_: t1: not active at that step
laws.note: "Ends" here is one step. B's Flow.ends_below, Flow.outrun_ends and Flow.ends_at_race_end are recorded as cases of it.

laws.if_: r2 of each of two: within what comes back, alone. r5: together above it at every step. The need is positive
laws.then_: t4 (what renews the stock) and t1: not active from some step on
laws.note: A named small model (one shared stock, whole numbers).

laws.if_: r4 of the drawer: none (it needs nothing of the stock). r2: above what comes back from T0 on
laws.then_: t1 (the drawer): lasts at every step and forms without bound; what does need the stock loses it for ever
laws.note: Docstring: "Persistence and success do not certify renewal."

laws.if_: a built case: every premise of the loss law met except the gate (something that needs nothing of the stock gives to it)
laws.then_: t1: not active at step 1, active from step 2 on
laws.note: Clean as a built CASE with a proved meeting (premise unmet: flow-gated), not as a law. The atlas stores it as an exit with drops = [flow-gated].

laws.if_: standing: activity needs support. t1: active at t. r4: lasts at least as strong as at T
laws.then_: t3: at step t it meets the earlier need (given back)

laws.if_: standing: activity needs support. t3: below the need at every step after T. t1: active at a later step
laws.then_: r4: weakened or dissolved by then
laws.note: The best case in the family for a relation being a line with marks of its own.

laws.if_: standing: activity needs support. r4: lasts unchanged after T. t3: below the need after T
laws.then_: t1: not active at every step after T

laws.if_: three built courses from one state, each breaking the same tie r4 at its first step
laws.then_: in one t1 ends; in one r4 dissolves as another forms and t1 lasts; in one t3 is given back and r4 is kept again
laws.note: Three cases whose point is that NO law decides. Also: which break is seen depends on reading at the step's start or its end (docstring).

laws.if_: NEW-any: holds at T, fails at a later t
laws.then_: not: no step between at which it ceased
laws.note: A rule for reasoning from two sightings to an unseen step.

laws.lean: Becoming.RegimeMargin.ends_iff_below (I read the adjusted form at RegimeMargin.lean:676; the atlas records the plain one as a case of it)
laws.if_: r2: a standing draw H, taken first. r3 has this form: read off what is left; short of the draw below y; nothing from nothing; meets the draw from y up to a top the step keeps. The start is at most the top
laws.then_: t3: ends (level nothing at some step) exactly where it starts below H + y; from H + y up it never falls below its start
laws.note: The family's central law. The border lies at an amount. Every IF clause but the start level is a form of r3.

laws.if_: r3: stops below the need m. r2: positive. Giving meets the draw at y
laws.then_: m ≤ y: the point of no return lies at least the draw above the need
laws.note: THEN is not a mark of a line. It says where a border lies relative to another line's need.

laws.if_: three regimes: draw H₁, draw H₂, both together; joint giving subadditive above the need and no greater than under either
laws.then_: a + b ≤ c + 1: the point rises under both by at least the sum of its rises under each, less one
laws.note: Compares three separately started regimes. Nothing changes along a course.

laws.if_: any fate of a level that is closed downward and read off an exact check
laws.then_: a least level separates the levels with that fate from the rest
laws.note: A law about borders in general. Docstring: every point of no return in the module is this law for its own reading and check.

laws.if_: r3 has this form: reads what is left and what was given last, rises in both, keeps a band
laws.then_: t3: comes to rest below the draw exactly where its level is below a threshold for what was given last; that threshold does not rise as the last giving rises
laws.note: This law was written after the field test MQ3 found the premise of the plain law unmet ("the level is not the state", experiments/margin-measured/README.md).

laws.if_: a built case: giving that does not rise with what is left
laws.then_: from 4 it rests at nothing, from 3 it rests at 3: no level separates
laws.note: Clean as a built case that meets the law with one premise unmet (rising).

laws.if_: t3: stands m above a need; each step raises it q or lowers it p, independent, balanced under the weights; n steps
laws.then_: t3: reaches the need within n steps on courses weighing at most n·p·q/m² of all
laws.note: THEN is a share of weighted courses. The mark needs "on at most this share of courses".

laws.if_: standing: balance, only what is active gives, activity needs support. r2: t1 takes at every step it is active from T. t4: nothing that is supplied gives to the stock meanwhile
laws.then_: t1: active for at most as many steps in a row as the stock's level at T
laws.note: A time equal to an amount. The exit Flow.fed_beyond_level_at is the same law turned round (lasting longer shows a supplied giver).

laws.if_: every other web that differs only in t1's own tie from T₀ on
laws.then_: t1 stays "consuming" on all of them exactly where its consuming shows through a tie the change leaves
laws.note: "Consuming" is a reading of a whole course, not a mark, and the law ranges over other courses. The entry: holds on the whole-run reading only.

laws.if_: r2: above what comes back from the start. r4 of t1: can move to another stock (a choice of the model)
laws.then_: t1: lasts at every step. r4: dissolves on the shared stock and forms on the other at a step that can be found. t4: not active from some step on
laws.note: One law, three THEN marks on three lines.

laws.if_: a chain of ties of one form (each gives nothing wherever nothing is left of the one before), a positive draw on each; t3 at the head: ends
laws.then_: t3 at every later link (t6): ends
laws.note: One link is clean (ends_of_partner). The law is that link carried along any path: a statement about the web's shape. The witness Chain.stopped: a link with no draw stops it.

laws.if_: r6: every giving rises with what is left of each; a band; every stock listed
laws.then_: the point of no return of one does not rise as any other's level rises
laws.note: How a border moves with another line's amount; no mark changes.

laws.if_: a built pair, each of which ends alone from every level
laws.then_: together they go round between (2, 3) and (3, 2) for ever, never at rest, neither ending
laws.note: Clean as a built case. The draft's "lasting by returning" holds here, of the pair and of neither member.

laws.if_: standing: activity needs support. A chain of r4 ties at positive need reaches y at step t; y: not active at t
laws.then_: t1 at the chain's other end: not active at t
laws.note: A path again. Same step, no lag; with a store the lagged form is Carries.chain_ends.

laws.if_: y is what another lives on exactly while y is active; the other's need of it is at most one; its level stays below that need after T
laws.then_: y: not active after T
laws.note: Here t1 and t3 are ONE thing. The draft's t-list is a list of places in a tie, not of things.

laws.if_: t1 is the whole of every part (active exactly while every part is); t2 (one part): ends
laws.then_: t1: ends
laws.note: The tie's form (every part / some part) decides. The witness Generations.allWhole_never: over the same parts the whole of every one is never active while the whole of some is always active.

laws.if_: the parts listed, their activity decided
laws.then_: t1: changed (some parts active and not all) exactly where the whole of some is active and the whole of every one is not

laws.if_: the parts arising and ceasing across a step are counted
laws.then_: count after + ceased = count before + arose
laws.note: A counting identity; no line is at any mark.

laws.if_: standing: balance, only what is active gives, activity needs support, descent. A family of stocks: gated, drawn above what comes back for n steps from a stock below n + m. r4: every later member of the line of descent needs the family at m or more
laws.then_: t1 (the line of descent): no member in any cohort after T + n
laws.note: What it gained by being picked within does not enter the proof (docstring).

laws.if_: each whole founded by one part; each next founder carries its founder's value
laws.then_: the mean founding value rises across a cohort of wholes exactly where the counts among wholes go for it
laws.note: A comparison of two counts (concord and discord). No line, no mark; picking with no rule.

laws.if_: standing: balance, activity needs support. r2 on a family of stocks: above what comes back for n steps, from a stock below n + m. r4: held at T + n by everything the line reaches. t1: active at a step not after T + n
laws.then_: t1 (read at the grain of its kind): ends on every branch
laws.note: The mark is relative to a sameness (the kind grain). The entry: it does not say that nothing of the kind stands later.

laws.if_: t3: given nothing for n steps. Cohorts at least double; each active member takes from it. level + 1 < 2ⁿ
laws.then_: not every member of the first n cohorts stays active
laws.note: Ends, with neither the member nor the step named; naming one asks activity to be decided (the entry's open list).

laws.if_: t3: any amount s ≥ 1
laws.then_: nothing follows for t1: some such course goes on and renews, some ends on every branch
laws.note: A pair of built cases packed as a negative law: this IF decides no mark.

laws.if_: NEW-kinds: a kind has no member
laws.then_: NEW-kinds: that kind does not form; every later history keeps none
laws.note: The same sentence as 无持者不复, no_entry_at_zero and empty_pool_preserved_by_core: what is absent is not made from within.

laws.if_: N draws from the last cohort each time, no kind favoured; a kind starts with h of N
laws.then_: NEW-kinds: ends as that kind alone on a share of the histories that tends to h/N
laws.note: A share of courses and a limit. The entry: counting weighs histories and supposes no chance of the unfolding.

laws.if_: r10: the rule is rebuilt only from what it picked, or not at all

counts: 65 rows typed: 64 Lean laws, each read from its statement and docstring (not its proof), and 1 reading that has no Lean. The family has 317 Lean laws (298 with premise rows, 19 exit-only); I read the statements of about 110. All 29 dynamics are covered. Split of the 65: clean 16 (3 of them only as built cases, not as laws), needs-comparison 14, needs-new-line 11, strained 17, does-not-fit 7. The sample is not random: it was chosen to take each dynamic's central law and its awkward ones, so the awkward kinds are over-represented. A rough count over the whole family by module, from the premise rows: about 129 laws about a stock, what lives on it, and the two rebuilding models (lines and marks hold, with comparisons; some 25 of these are witnesses); about 75 laws of any line (returning, forks, regions, gates, draining); 43 regime laws, most of them about a border; 22 about shares of weighted courses; 29 in the periphery (the market model, slowing down). Of the 857 premises these laws take, 746 are hypotheses of one law, 63 are standing premises of the World model, 31 are commitments of the representation, 17 are local (decided, listed); 23 laws take a premise about what is decided or listed.
what_does_not_fit:
1. LAWS OF ANY LINE (about 75 of 317). Run.stays, Gated.kept_along_iff, 闭则不出, Lasting.lasts_iff_ladder say what lasting IS: every step taken keeps it. Run.leaving_needs, 内至外之线有出步, Gated.leaving_passes_gate, ceases_at_a_step say what ending IS: one step that does not keep it, placed on the course (one law, the root's 两端分则中有标, proved four times here). loss_passes_juncture: a loss of what could come back passes a fork. Gated.origin: forming enters only at a gated step. Lines and marks hold these only with a schematic line "any line". They are the map's key, and the rules by which sightings are reasoned from (in, then out: a step between did not keep it). They should not be drawn as ties between named lines.

2. LAWS THAT COMPARE AMOUNTS. Held, with the comparison slot, when the amount places a border between two marks of one line (ends_iff_below: start below H + y) or bounds a time (unfed_consumption_ends). Missed when the law is about the border itself: where it lies (root_above_need), how it moves with another line's amount (three threshold_falls laws, rises_by_draw), how two add (rises_superadditive), whether one exists (leading_exact; Notch.no_threshold). About 25 laws. These need the border as a thing with properties. Most also compare separately started courses, which is not a change along a course; the atlas calls them "tipping in a parameter" and the draft's "changes" would blur the two.

3. THE SHAPE OF A WEB. The one-link law is clean (a tie of total dependence, the upstream ends, so the downstream ends). The chain (ends_downstream, coextinct, chain_ends with lags) is that law carried along any path, and the ring (ends_together) says two lines' marks are equal. They are statements about the map's own graph. Strained, not missed: store the link law once with "carries along chains: proved / with lags / stops at a link with no draw (Chain.stopped)", and let the map compute what lies downstream.

4. SHARES OF COURSES (22 laws: exit-from-a-margin, drift, ended_falls_back). THEN is "this mark, within n steps, on at most this share of the weighted courses". The four marks miss it unless a mark carries over which courses it holds: this one, every one, some one, at most a share, every allowed disturbance (Lasting).

5. COUNTING IDENTITIES. Grade.across_step, GroupEnding.rises_iff_ended, Founding.Nested.raises_iff_among: equalities among counts. No line is at a mark. They are bookkeeping other laws use.

6. WITNESSES (20 of the 40 exits, and about 30 more among the laws). They fit, as the draft says, as built cases, and better than as exits: a witness is a built case that meets a law with every premise but one, and the THEN fails (Restored.returns without the gate; Chain.stopped without a positive draw; Notch without rising giving). The atlas's `drops` field is that unmet premise. A second kind does not fit so simply: two or three built courses from one start showing that an IF decides no mark (loss_does_not_decide; Handover.both_fates and stock_forces_neither; OneWay.possibly_not_necessarily). The meeting record needs "premise unmet" and "shows: fails without it / not decided".

7. CALIBRATIONS. 尽则有终当且仅当排中, Map.end_of_gone_iff_excluded_middle, lpo_of_junctures_found, Web.lpo_of_ending, chain_ends_of_em. Missed as laws on the map. What they say is that a mark held by reasoning ("ends on every branch") is not a mark located ("ends at this step"), and what locating costs. They belong on the mark (step named or not) and in the key.

8. LAWS ABOUT WHAT A SIGHTING TELLS. SlowingDown.fold_margin_read and need_not_read; Irreversibility.constant_reading_hides_loss; FiniteSupportObstruction.projected_recovery_and_actual_failure (a state looks recovered with one coordinate left out while its full history stops); the Crossing docstring (the same break is seen or not by reading at the step's start or end); Substitution.stepwise_includes_substitution (whole-run against stepwise reading); the docstring of Flow.family_excess_ends (one stock read alone shows no excess while the family read as one runs down). The draft has no place for these. They are the Lean's own statements about the relation between reasoning and observation, which is the goal Ren named.

9. A READING WITH NO LAW. four-routes-of-transition has no declaration. It is a sorting of ways a kept region is left.

10. LAWS OF ONE MODEL IN NUMBERS (the market entries; the Peaked, Relay, Momentum instances). The draft says a law speaks of any situation that meets its IF. These speak of one supplied model at given numbers ("in the original example at β = 1/2"). They are nearer to built cases.
one_map:
One map, and family A needs none of its own. But A is not a neighbourhood of it. Its name is a mark, and so are F's, G's and H's (cycles; rest; kept regions, renewal, generation), while B, C, D, E are named by lines. A is where laws conclude "ends" for lines other families treat under "lasts": the two rebuilding models are filed in both A and H with 13 Lean declarations in common (6 of RuleRebuilding, 7 of ReaderRebuilding), and Flow.never_returns_below is under both.

Joined to the first region by Lean: (1) FourReaders.recoverable_iff_regime (ReadOffInTime.lean:1097) equates "recoverable" in B's reading-a-loss-in-time with A's RegimeMargin.step not ending; (2) GroupEnding.Flow.coupled_generation_childless carries H's persisting-filters-what-was-chosen into A's selection-among-groups-by-ending; (3) the TimedResponse premises are taken by A's fork law and by the first region's laws; (4) premise drift-replacement-valueby is taken by A's drift laws and by C's shaping-read-by-readers-drawn-from-the-selected. In all, 17 ledger premises are shared between A and the first region's 21 dynamics. No row of rows.json has an A law as its Lean.

What A adds to the first region is the ground under three of its answers. The first region's cast already has "what is used up" (t3) and what lives on it (t1, t6). Its question `on` has the answer `ended` with no Lean and no premise; `time: too-late` rests on a point of no return. A's laws are what those are.

Joined to other families by Lean: B's Flow.stays_below, Flow.ends_below, Flow.outrun_ends, Flow.ends_at_race_end are recorded as cases of A's laws; G's and F's regime entries share RegimeMargin.Adjusted.comes_to_rest with A, with case_of links both ways; H's never-leaving-a-guard and A's not-going-out-of-a-region are joined by Lasting.avoids_iff_closed.

Where "one set of lines" is only a reading: of the 363 distinct ledger premises A's laws take, 274 are taken by no other family. The root's predicates (闭, 退化, Absorbing, Returns, Invariant) appear in Attraction, Junctures, Lasting, RuleRebuilding, ReaderRebuilding, LineageRegimes and MapInstances, and in none of RegimeMargin, Continuation, Dependence, Reserve, Wholes, Interdependence, Drift, Gated, GroupEnding, Founding (grep counts of 0). The Lean itself warns of three senses of "returns" (Recurrence.lean:128: a state had again; a tie met again; a loop of couplings). better:
1. GIVE EVERY MARK ITS SAMENESS AND ITS EXTENT. The root says the marks belong to an occurrence and "the answers depend on the class" (01 §3), and it has separate words for a whole line: goes on along some branch, ends on every branch, reaches an end (02 §1). The draft keeps the root's words and drops that structure. In A, "ends" then merges predicates the Lean proves apart: not active now; never active from here; for good (a separate premise, web-ending-final); on every branch with no step named (to name one is excluded middle). A mark should be: line, at which sameness, which of the four, how far (at a step / over n steps / from here on / cannot come back), over which courses (this / every / some / a share). In plain words for ending: out now, stays out, cannot come back.

2. KEEP THINGS AND PLACES APART. t1 to t9 are places in a tie ("what it lives on"), not things. In a chain one thing is "what it lives on" for the next and "something that goes on" for itself (web-embodied). Laws should be written over places, cases over things, and the bridge is the binding of things to places. The one map is one web of places and ties.

3. GIVE TIES A FORM. Most decisive IF clauses in A are neither marks nor amounts but how one line hangs on another: at once or through a store; every part or some part; wholly or partly; what gives back itself needing it (the gate); read off the level or off the level and the last giving; rebuilt from what it picked, from outside, from the level. A tie record needs a form field beside its four marks.

4. FOUR KINDS OF IF CLAUSE, which premises.json already types: marks on lines; forms of ties; standing premises of the model (balance, activity needs support, whole-number amounts); what must be decided or listed. Only the first two and part of the third can be assessed in a case; the fourth says whether the THEN can be located.

5. MARK EACH IF CLAUSE BY WHETHER A SIGHTING CAN MEET IT. "Below the need at every later step" cannot be seen; "over these n steps" can. The Lean already pairs them (stays_below against stays_below_at; ended against ends_within_on). This is the hinge between reasoning and observation, and it should show on every tie.

6. MORE KINDS OF LAW than forms, lasts, changes, ends, border: of any line (the key); about a border (where, how it moves, whether it exists); compares (separately started courses or rules, not a change along one); decides nothing (a pair of built cases); what locating takes (calibrations); what a sighting of one line tells of another.

7. WIDEN "WHAT FAILED". A proved law cannot fail on data; the claim that a kind of case meets its IF can. The margin tests show at least five things failing apart: a premise of the IF (MQ3, "the level is not the state"); the bridge (learners not reaching the best response); the rule for reading a mark (MQ6 A1 counted noise at the instrument's floor as survival); the protocol (MQ1 A3, round 1); power. That README's own ledger classes each prediction as identity, deterministic limit, manipulation, law + bridge, or beyond the law: take that as a field. Add "led to": MQ3's failure led to the laws of threshold-in-the-state-plane. Add to the bridge its reading: which things are read as one (a stock alone or its family), when in the step, step by step or over the whole run.

8. DO NOT DRAW FAMILIES AS REGIONS. Keep them as an index. On the map A, F, G and H are marks and ways of lasting on lines that B, C, D, E name.

9. LINES TO ADD OR REWORD: a store it carries; the kinds among them and their shares (the draft has a rule that picks "among them" and no line for them); "any line". Reword t7 and r8: in A things are picked among with no rule, by which of them end. Add "on a store" to the ways of lasting.
